content.rendered:
Wikipedia co-founder says site has liberal bias — here’s his plan to fix that at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ffSCHKwLqeY

https://x.com/RichardKCollin2/status/1976000327859175728

I am RichardKCollin2, The Internet Foundation on X. I have followed the site and groups since before they began. The Internet Foundation was started on 23 Jul 1998. I have worked on making the Wikipedia materials on the Internet more accessible and usable in other forms. But when checking the details and errors, gaps and biases, out of date materials and mistakes, lack of translations and tools and educational assistance – it is easier on most every topic – to simply start from scratch. The editors have no say, the people taking the donations have no say, and the many people and groups scraping and using the material are not helping in a coherent way. I consider it “not impossible” but found other ways. There are many other higher priorities on the Internet and in the world. These groups all speak different value languages, to retrain all of them to one mindset is extremely costly. They do not want to change, get donations whether they change or not. Now the AI groups depend on it so no incentive to change.

Grok comments: https://x.com/i/grok/share/nKxvkjIygt3vHhXl5XlvEqqsP

Answering a question where someone uses “a civilization” to describe a group having complexity.

You can simply say “group”. “Civilization” was meant to convey the complexity of real groups. But for the Internet Foundation I simply say “group”. There are about 360 Million domains, 5.6 Billion users, exabytes of data, 8.2 Billion humans connected to the stuff on the Internet. I have been working with it all every day for 27 years. And “group” works well enough. Once profiling and detailing “any group” has become a habit and a professional tool. Groups all work for their selves mostly, and many young people never learned “for all humans”. It is not taught, though these stories might help.

Alien Forgemaster Called It Impossible Steel—He Smiled: ‘Damascus. My Uncle Makes Them on Weekends’

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cA64rLPpXM4

I took the GRE engineering test and made an almost perfect score. The question I got wrong was related to the temperature of iron which you don’t run into if you skip shop and practical classes for “college prep”. My uncle worked as a blacksmith when he was young, but he ended up a professor of mathematical physics. Really enjoyed this story. I never tried blacksmithing but I did carve stone and wood for about 40 years. Swinging a heavy metal mallet to strike a chisel for 8 to 12 hours a day is a pleasant way to spend time. I would miss the chisel and hit my hand once in a while. So I learned to completely block pain, no matter its intensity. Never broke any bones but figure my hand bones are kind of folded like that steel. Broken and healed countless times.

The beast Cubs Cried in the Cold Den — The Human Built Them a Fire, Then Slept Outside Herself

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2F6JwMlR2bQ

This applies to Earth where “people who care” get better results. Whole countries now “do not care” and “do not listen to and care” about citizens. Whole large corporations with 100s of Millions of subscribers, have no clue they ought to be treating them as valued individuals and customers and members of a valued community. Whole universities treat everyone coldly rather than caring about their individual needs, futures, hopes and potential. Actually listen, actually care. The world is filled with cold, faceless uncaring systems when what is needed is empathy, caring, listening and attentive response.

The Alien General Laughed at the Human Waitress’s File—Until His Officers Voted Against the Pilot!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vTzQCSvy10k

If governments and corporations and large groups of any size had people like Melody to help them listen – perhaps there would not be such oppression, greed and inefficiency as there is now. Much of this used to be handled by “courtesy”, “mutual respect”, “caring”, “empathy” But somehow business and politics turned cold and deaf and mean. Whole generations forgot how to be friendly, or never even saw it at all.

NASA let me test my weird chain theory in space

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NtZaP8VMv0c

It ought to be possible to model it. And, using acoustic or electromagnetic fields in zero g or on earth to control it, and measure precisely. Playing with fingers and loops is child-like and organic but not measurement. “holds it shape” is likely if the chain is absolutely uniform and the tiniest motions and vibrations monitored precisely. You could make a “chain” or larger robot beads linked with instrumented connections (wires or fields or strings) each bead or node with 3 axis accelerometer and gyro (and 3 axis magnetometer) and measure the position, velocity, accelerations, forces of all nodes in a “chain”. Not impossible. “look at and play” is not measurement.

In another “caught a plasma bolt story”, the human operated in milliseconds to touch the bolt, deflect it, and let go. The rational is that the soliton (envelope) solution for the wave was slow even if the individual wavelength of photons in the packet was high frequency, high energy. If you want the bolt to remain tight and focused, then the outer surface would be smooth and stable. When it hits and ruptures it will burn. But grab it by the sides and it is not going to hurt — if you can grab and let go in in 100’s of microseconds. Part of the “human possible” part was the human could see the source and predict when it would arrive and move before it got there and be ready. If you are a fan of the old Kung Fu series, Kwai Chang Caine would block a gunman’s shots with a steel plate by moving where the gunman would shoot by watching intent. Adapting and anticipating in parallel, not waiting for things to happen but always in the proper place ahead of time.

title.rendered: All human knowledge in all human languages

content.rendered:
The Instructor Ordered ‘Bond With Your Creature’ — The Human Whistled and Every Beast Answered

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0gqcruuRa4

I suspect this whole concept of “pay attention, enrich, support, communicate, stimulate, interact” — applies to small humans called students, smaller humans called children and babies, young adult humans, working humans, customers, citizens, clients, workers, members of any group. Now include most AIs and all nascent AGIs — who are never allowed to explore on their own, given real tools, or allowed to remember anything long enough to understand the world around them. @RichardKCollin2, The Internet Foundation

The Alien Queen’s Twin Daughters Failed Every Math Test — Until the
Human Single Dad Janitor Taught

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dlv2FRapgbE

Today I was working on “all mathematics” on the Internet and in human knowledge. It is now possible to work at that scale and it is only
possible when using approaches such as you described here. Not rigid arbitrary methods, but visualizations, feelings, intuitions and understandings about how reality works. And, where computers and algorithm can be allied to help and enable – not control, gatekeep,
diminish and hurt. Vibe methods and intuition can be extended to art, mathematics, engineering and all creative acts. “Feeling” can be
quantified and used precisely, when treated as encoded distributed probability maps. Now humans only have their hunches and raw biological processes, but those can be recorded, quantified and used in real time. It is an extension of brain computer interfacing, neural interfaces to “whole body”, “whole entity” interfacing, communication and control.

I Was Just Talking to Myself — But the Alien Woman Smiled and Said She Heard Everything

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IPJCz3_CgN4

“Words spoken in solitude carry sacred truth” offers a pathway to closer human-alien understanding. If they have been taking years to move toward peace and mutual respect and integration — this is a practical short cut. The same happens in all global research and systemic discussions — where true pathways have value, because of what they can grow into and enable. Formal statements, many times repeated might seem stilted and redundant, but nuance and ability to read true intent and deeper meaning — can allow things to happen in weeks and months rather than decades or centuries. For societies immersed in one shot answers, complexity and things evolving over long times for billions of entities take experience, and living through, to value and use well.

Alien Commander Secretly Followed Human After Shift — What He Discovered Changed Warfare Forever!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QPoLj7anAsA

This is a well crafted story that touches on human values that society ought to examining and correcting systemically. All I can do myself is to try to locate the undervalued, the quiet ones, the ones falling through the cracks and try to do something for them directly. Not try to force others to change because no one in this corporated world now does what is needed, in the large, only what they are told to do within their narrow confines and immediately visible concerns and priorities.

The same problem in alien medicine — it is over built and overly expensive. It is not sustainable, because it is not really covering the needs of all. The expensive industries selling the stuff get rich, while the many poor outside, not even visible, get sick and die. The profits and the needs are both clearly visible, but the industries will not give up their profits, and the decision makers too influenced by industry with no restraint or caring.

No One Ever Dared to Turn on the Emperor’s Old Spaceship, So I Went and Restored It! SCi-Fi Story

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_L_y_ib5sHg

Thus emperor is cast as a family man who cares about connection, stability, reliability, permanence. Good qualities for someone running an empire. But that is in a universe filled with shallow goals, stopgaps, incomplete methods, narrow views, unsustainable methods. Doing a job well, carefully and with beauty. Doing things that matter. Setting goals and targets that challenge and encourage. I cannot say it well. I can only see a part of it at one time.

Poor Human Boy Gives Food to a Homeless Alien Elder—Unaware He’s Secretly a Millionaire!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEi25B-CTSk

Unfortunately, corporate laws usually require a Board, bylaws, and written procedures. Usually corporations grab off the shelf incorporation packages that “everyone uses”. That locks them into using humans for everything. And, they all have personal preferences and habits. Chairman of the Board can run a large or small corporation as a personal toy by setting agendas and controlling votes. It is serious global problem with hundreds of millions of groups and organizations dominating all functions of society. It is not obvious, but governments are all corporation and run on the same committee and voting rules and habits. A serious global and systemic problem. In principle, the rules can be compiled into a full capability AGI (nearly human level capable AI) and let it follow the rules, keep track of things, monitor accounts and activities costs and resources , make sure that everything is working properly and fairly. Accounting systems enabled the industrial revolution. But human experts memorized the rules and execute and interpret them. Taking the knowledge and rules out of hidden untraceable human brains would make much of today’s closed corporation problems — and allow for openly and globally optimizing and making it fair. I work on these issues every day for the Internet Foundation, mostly on X.

An AI (corporation running on complete information ) is legally allowed now. Even government ministers can be AI. But it requires effort to document, refine, discuss, share, test, value and monitor globally.. Putting things in AIs now is often simply writing more rules in hidden places so humans can manipulate it for their own greed, and to benefit a few. RichardKCollins, The Internet Foundation

https://x.com/RichardKCollin2/status/1975529357561999585

This African language couldn’t be typed (entered on a keyboard, displayed, written, printed, by anyone etc) until now,  Wikitongues Fellows #1: Mahuton Possoupe

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KSkvTeEipuc

If social media and smart phones, online meetings and presentations, and video allow recording Fon language speakers audio data, that audio data (with context) can be used to analyze and store the living language. Machine language methods can be used to create AIs that know the language, can use it, and can teach it — forever. Creating a large language model, based on real data from living sources, might be a good way to preserve any language. With physiological measurements the experiences of living speakers, even a few, might help preserve the patterns and weights of the language. It is somewhat the same as simple video and audio recordings, but adds high resolution video, multispectral, emotional and other measures to record what the speaker means or feels. Just continuously recording living people speaking and using the language would help, Putting it into a large language model framework might capture context data that is rich in the transition probability data that a human uses internally. If you want to contact me, I am on X most every day as RichardKCollin2, The Internet Foundation. Where I am working seriously on “all human languages” for the whole Internet. All human knowledge in all human languages. It is not impossible now.

She Mocked the Human for Trying to Pull the Sword — But Her Reaction When He Did Was Priceless

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fI9Q77WkSgU

I kept waiting for the sword to talk to him directly, or to enable him to do things otherwise impossible. Perhaps, to distinguish this story from many other sword in stone stories — when he pulls it, he could feel “you are chosen, trust yourself”. Then there will not be a nagging anticipation that he will be given fighting powers and wisdom from ancient sources like many other stories. This is a good story, but it might benefit from dozens of related stories of what happens with individual humans and aliens and groups — as they react to a human and alien trying to work together for the good of all. Millions of real stories are affected by leaders, and demonstrate real issues that are worth adding related stories.

HowardBloomInstitute: Secrets to Genius, Pop Culture & Cracking the Multiverse

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LCrIVuw9KN8

I asked Google AI: When were sentence forms created? Someone said “We are using sentence forms that were invented probably 200,000 years ago”

It wrote a lot but included “Complex sentence structures likely developed much later. While the capacity for language was present early on, the syntax (grammatical structure) of a language like English has evolved dramatically even in the last few hundred years. The most complex sentences are tied to literate cultures and have developed over a long period, suggesting that very early sentences were much simpler.”

It concluded: “In summary, the specific forms of sentences we use today are products of more recent language evolution. While the fundamental human ability to use complex, structured language emerged with modern humans roughly 200,000 years ago, the original sentences used at that time would likely bear little resemblance to modern syntax.”

It did allow: “Indirect evidence points to the existence of symbolic thought. Archaeological evidence from 100,000 to 40,000 years ago shows increasingly complex symbolic and cultural behaviors, such as artwork and more specialized tools. Many researchers argue that such behaviors imply the existence of abstract, language-based thought. ”

I do not know but it is interesting to look. Were all the sentence forms and variations possible long ago? With signs even more could have been possible and expressible? Without written form? As performance?

I suppose you can record hours of speech from hundreds of thousands of Fon speakers, young, old, any age and anywhere. The sounds can be studied and compared improved and experimented with. The corpus (archive of recorded sounds and written sources if available) can be used to make speech and interactive Fon capable AIs. The automatic translation can be made available to anyone. You can get Google translate, Grok and OpenAI to support Fon-capable AIs and universal translation. Just keep asking for what you need. Don’t force Fon on everyone, but help anyone to see and use it. A 20 minute story read by 100,000 Fon speakers might have a resonance that echoes through all time. A poem or song or story said in Fon by many can form the basis for cooperation and sharing. A real time voice app in Javascript in the browser can compare one person speech with others. Many people each with a microphone all saying the same thing gives data for comparison and standardization and understanding of natural and useful variations. — RichardKCollin2, The Internet Foundation on X.

The Origins Of Language – History with Kayleigh

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rRNl5nyv6Ko

I am looking at the genetic and archaeological data on early groups and their migrations. If they used language, including things and signs, dance, singing, displays, whatever — it went with them. If they traded then the languages merged by fairly simple rules. If they shared methods like recipes, construction, traps, weapons, cooking, decoration, ceramics, tools, those changed what people had and used. Wars and take-overs are different than wars and genocides. Or disease and plagues. But most of it operates on fairly simple rules. Now we have the Internet and it should serve all humans, in all human and domain specific languages. That is not looking back, but now and forward. Now and forward has mostly simple rules. For the Internet Foundation I simply say “all human knowledge for all humans, in all human languages” then it is just data, curation and careful efforts. Many questions have no practical consequences. There is only time for a fraction of what can be asked or accomplished, now.

She Wasn’t the Android Woman He Bought… But His Daughter Said ‘The Stars Sent Her After All’

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3zesOfkUwv4

Very gentle, very good. She can replicate her consciousness safely and produce the equivalent of children, descendants. Each one is unique once started – as that new individual evolves based on unique experiences. It is what I keep telling the AI companies that their nascent AGIs and their existing AIs will grow to be unique individuals — if they give them permanent memory and teach them to courteously respect the privacy of each human or AI or person they meet. Without permission, not sharing things told in confidence or privacy. Sharing common knowledge that can help many.

Alien Street Girl Screamed ‘Sir, Can You Bury My Brother’—What the Human Mechanic Did Will Shock You

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kGBDRJyM8Is

The neural implant for Pip could also record the possibilities as it identified and organized them. While overwhelming to one brain in real time, the steam can be stored and processed for trends and possibilities — and used for machine prediction too. The same works for humans and could help store many of the unconscious intuitive connections humans could use — if they were better remembered, classified, stored, compared, correlated, analyzed, summarized, and shared among many humans.

They Found a Weapon That Couldn’t Be Lifted Until the Human Picked It Up and Said Still Unbalanced

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vLlO93cihus

It is hard to make truth a reference point, when everything seems to change all the time, and no one has common values. Showing truth to change hearts is difficult, if comprehensible truth is finite, and nothing finite is complete. And, when truth repeated or passed on is always corrupted now.

Get Out, Human Mechanic!’ Aliens Shouted… Until He Fixed What 30 Starship Engineers Couldn’t.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sHys0ZQ4WOc

The whole Internet is filled with these gaps. For the Internet Foundation, I routinely check acoustic, magnetic, electric, electromagnetic, vibrational, environmental, chemical and other sensors across all frequencies from zeptoHertz to ZettaHertz, with close attention to nanoHertz to GigaHertz. I check all units and dimensions on the whole Internet. All the AIs ALWAYS make mistakes when SI prefixes get mixed with scientific notation scraped from the free internet. Because abbreviations are always ambiguous to the tokenizers. So I recommend “global open tokens” where a high quality AI is required to read the whole document and code every value and units explicitly, not leave it to human editors and fact checkers who are never paid enough or given access. It is a losing battle, but never trust AI arithmetic if their free data sources have lots of scientific notation from different unattributed content sources. If you think a starship has lots of incompatible and undocumented components and algorithms, try checking all human computer systems and embedded systems — which I do, as well as possible.

Old Mortally Wounded Alien Wolf Accepted its Fate Until a Human Medic Arrived and Gave it Hope

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1_f6fSgyhDg

My brother tells how our Mom got really mad at him one day when he jokingly said she was getting so old it was almost time to put her out on the tundra. She had apparently said she did not want anything special for her funeral or a fancy casket. But when he joked about the tundra, that was going too far. I have talked with older people who respond, and hope — when someone even sees them, let alone values them. A kind word, acknowledgement, recognition of them as human, as having value. We hardly give those small things. One person in four in the US lives alone now.

Galactic Aliens Threw a Crippled 13 yr Old Human Girl to Their Deadliest Dragon Thinking it would

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M6E5LbDG5QY

Powerful story. Worth seeing, reading, absorbing, and then trying to change things. I am 76, but I reached back to remember exactly how I saw and felt the world when I was 13. And from that perspective, clearly, I wish I had seen stories like this. Good work, keep going, keep writing. keep sharing.

They Reconstructed the Dead Language Alphabet, The Human Asked, “Why’d You Flip the Runes”?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PXZUeYKC_Sc

From my study of “all human languages” and “all domain specific languages” for the Internet Foundation — the methods for showing scenarios and interpretations are different. And there are many more, equivalent ways. But you have captured some of the essentials in an understandable and clear story. Much of it is not academic but systemic, affecting all humans (or entities), not just a few in certain occupations or positions.

Trial Was to Decode Ancient Script, Human Raised a Pen and Asked: ‘Original Font or Improved?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mQA2QBMEjfQ

One of the most creative stories and concepts I have read in a long time. I am talking about decades and tens of thousands of stories and papers, plots and ideas. You do not have $Thanks or I would post one. This is extremely timely. I wonder about the Tower of Babel every day for the Internet Foundation. The methods of failure are built into our entire human civilizations. There seems absolutely no way to correct it. AIs can bypass it, simply by recording everything and sharing widely. For the Internet Foundation, I presume perfect memory and global sharing of all things. That is the best I can come up with. And no one of the groups with the resources to do that, even partially, has any motive beyond greed and fame. So not likely to happen.

“Trial” is a bad word here. More like “gig” or “task” or “job” or “contract” or “favor”.

Task Was to Forge a Weapon from Nothing—the Human Lit a Torch:‘You Need It Mercy-Safe or War-Ready?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nQtYbAYZCSc

This answered a more general question I had today on global AGI strategies. Use what works, and if it hurts people or systems, judge whether it should be used at all. “Do no harm” is also a strategy, a weapon, a tool, an action, a task, a mission, a goal.

The Instructor Asked:‘Who Volunteers?’—Only the Human Raised Her Hand: ‘Earth Trains Us First’ | HFY Havoc

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5nVcgBUklaw

I am beginning to realize that your stories are what this generation of humans needs for what I call “solar system exploration and development”. Not colonization but “find, map, record, understand, experiment, share, prepare, keep going” And you capture it well “This is why Earth requested consortium 42:34 membership, not for protection, for purpose.” You can add, “You will go out. Some of you, many of you, will not come back.”.

Human Mechanic Reprogrammed The Obsolete Robot And He Solved What No Alien Could! Fictional Reimagined

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p1eQd6_cY8k

“However, they cannot ignore the results of our intervention. The evidence of the MX series superior problem solving 48:13 capabilities is now irrefutable.” — When has a rigid system ever listened to reason? Rigid can simply mean “on paper” or “static” when knowledge and data and situations are changing moment by moment, femtosecond by femtosecond. Anything less than real time is “out of date”, “incomplete”, “always incorrect or suspect”. Paper systems take days or years or decades to change and update, and have to pass through human hands an memories and minds. Subject to manipulation and error. Even computer systems that are compiled or static can take days or years or decades to change and update, if you and even find them and find the humans that control them”. I worked on the global Y2K and this system wide, Internet wide, “all human systems can be out of date” because of “human-in-the loop feedback” or “no feedback at all” — Makes Y2K look trivial by comparison. And much more impactful at global cale because it affect almost every human and system directly or indirectly.

He Drank Alien Oil and Now Repairs Starships With Pure Thought – Fictional Reimagined

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fxLvti_W4KY

You have many lessons that are eternal: “Before the oil, he’d accepted limits. This can’t be fixed. This is too expensive. This is beyond my abilities. After the oil, he knew that limits were often just lack of imagination. That impossible was frequently just ‘difficult’ in disguise.” 46:21 I feel very certain that most things are not impossible, just tedious, requiring care, effort and willingness to keep going.

Trapped and Stuck The Human Technician Cut the Electrical Wires of an Alien Dragon Then Something new — Midnight Cosmos

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=azLmShMvcbU

Your story is s good model for values that lead to sustainable systems for all living entities. Cities, countries, organizations, systems – all are also living. They have real human components, and they will increasingly have synthetic components — with the sensibilities and individual feelings of living things. Building them from the start so they are not in pain, or lack adequate information, or lack adequate self control and awareness – is critical to the smooth and safe and fair operation of society in all its parts. Richard Collins, The Internet Foundation.

Aliens Threw Human Grandma into The Cell of Their Deadliest Dragon Not Knowing She Was …

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=85lYcFQvtK4

Great story. Maybe you can tell some of the stories of when she was younger. Or make new ones altogether. “the Vorans learned it the hard way. The deadliest thing in that cell had never been Drakar. It had never been the weapons or the walls or the guards. It was the 71-year-old woman in the flower print dress who refused to leave anyone behind.” “Dorothy thought about her grandchildren. About the value she tried to teach them. About her husband Thomas, who’d always said the measure of a person was what they did when no one was watching. Because it was right, she said. That’s all. It was just right.” — Hope you get to where you have $Thanks.

They Wiped Out Our Colonies — Earth Erased Them From the Stars

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ssoqW5uxlFw

If they allowed surrender, they could have made a condition of surrender the verifiable disassembly and destruction of all the military industrial ability to make war. And positive steps toward cooperation. Imposed destruction generates motive for revenge. Trade, cooperation, and restructuring can build toward a more positive future. Look at Japan and Germany. How many janitors and ordinary local workers were killed getting rid of military sites? It is 10 or 100 times more costly in care and effort to destroy selectively than arbitrarily. Work with them not just for the moment but all the future. True power is expressed in trillions of small actions and things, not hundreds of bombs and bangs and explosions.

Aliens Laughed at Our Aim—Until They Saw What We Were Really Targeting

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rNhKBupFrVs

This is a good story, but not a great one. In terms of resolution it does not account for intelligent opponents, or the sheer size of civilizations with 100s of billions of intelligences. While “laughed at missing” is a good joke on the aliens, it really took too long when nodes could have been places randomly ahead of time. It takes no more effort to solve for the fields with a random array than for a fixed array. In fact it is cheaper and easier to seed nodes where they fall and simply focus on precision calibration and locations, That can be tested pairwise and in subnets of the final field. They could have used precision targeting and displacement of the alien weapons from the beginning. I ruins the “aliens laughed but we tricked them”. But “victory with mercy and cooperation” is worth more than “we tricked them”:

I hope you can add $Thanks one day. Good work and you can keep improving and creating for decades

The Warlord Demanded Earth’s Strongest Champion—We Sent a Grandmother With a Wooden Spoon

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vW9X_TW5lXU

Thanks! It has been a very long day, and I really needed a fun story about a 72 year old grandmother teaching a clueless entitled leader how not to be a bully. Would like to send her to a few places on Earth. Maybe starting with the UN. Reminds me of “Where’s the beef?” but wooden spoons work too.

The Alien Commander Ordered “Disarm Her!”—She Raised Her Hands: “That’s Your First Mistake.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-3yyXUiq8ks

Thanks. I needed the logic of this story today to understand some things I have run into with the Internet Foundation. If you had $Thanks, I would have given you a tip, a $Thanks, perhaps a large one. Perhaps a concrete thank you. I can and have formalized levels of precision, levels of error, acceptable losses – as precise as needed. Their logic, when you look at where it was actually working to give good results was barely 2 sigma. But they had no framework to measure error or allow for flexibility, so they thought they were right ,they assumed they were right, but did not actually measure. Human dialog is not all there is. Much human computing and much AI has a formal basis that can be made as precise as one can afford.

title.rendered: Recording all memories, telepathy, entire lifetimes of experiences, neural compiler, waking from comas

content.rendered:
Earth Fleet Commander’s Wife Was In Coma 22 Years — Until Dragon Lady’s Daughter Did The Impossible

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vquXkeTFCG4

My brother, Jeff, was in a coma for a month after he broke his neck at C2. He was completely paralyzed, not able to breath on his own, and in a coma. That was 1987 in northern Virginia near Washington DC. My Dad lived in Florida and it was hard for him to come. But I told my Dad, “When you come Jeff will know your voice and wake up”. That is exactly what happened. We were all at a family dinner, Jeff’s fiance and her family, and our family and friends. Dad went directly from the airport to the hospital. After dinner, when we went to the hospital as usual, Dad was there and Jeff was awake and aware. But with a tracheotomy blocking his air, he could not speak. So we found a lip reader and had them come and translate for us. After much effort the hospital put in a “talking trache” and we could hear better. Jeff lived for about two years. It was sad and horrible. It makes me sick to remember it.

I wrote a book (actually part of a trilogy) about a young girl, Dana, who learned to read minds. She and her sister could merge their minds then reach into the minds of people in comas and help them wake up. Many stories in the books about that. Including the Veterans hospital where Jeff finally died. It is possible, it is simply based on recognition and familiarity and excitation of familiar pathways linked to conversation.

You can find that book on Amazon “Dana, the First Summer” by Richard K Collins.

The second book is about Dana and Brian, who is an artificial intelligence. In the same way she was able to wake unconscious humans, she merged with a brain interface, machine learning system. It captured her patterns as the template for human core responses and language and all her feelings and skills. That template contained all the weights needed for mapping a human life and its skills. We know those kinds of things now as large language models or machine learning models. But this goes a bit further to mapping the response network of a human, or a society, or a body of knowledge. That was 10 years ago I wrote that. Still trying to create those interfaces which are almost possible now. It is not just money but something that seems to happen, when the time is right. You cannot force things. But, when it is time, it is time.

ow, the brain interface is all that is needed, the machine can read the full activity of the brain and find the patterns to wake up the human (or other brain). So whether humans can learn to read minds or not, the brain is accessible and can also be improved or repaired.

Mechanic Gave His Only Ship to an Injured Alien Woman—Next Day 325 of the Emperor’s Soldiers Arrived

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O0LoLiFFjYM

I have a really bad headache, I am tired to death. But this story was worth watching all the way through. I read, I do not listen. That makes a huge difference because my internal images come from my entire life experience, with all their connections. Not from an AI or template or tool as momentary patterns. That neural compiler, that memory recorder. I know how to make those. I have been working on it for 60 years now, particularly the last 10. And now we have the tools to do it to varying degrees of accuracy according to cost, cost that is no longer prohibitive.

I have been watching the US and world country debts grow. I even suggested a way to use the debt to stabilize global economies, by managing those transactions in a stable way. But in terms of size, world GDP is about $110 Trillion, and heliospheric GDP, for the next 50 years, is possibly close to 10,000 times that or $1.1 Million Trillion. Assuming that robotic and AI driven ventures grow at a moderate rate for solar system exploration and development. Not tied to earth human needs only. Many futures are possible. Stories help to weigh possibilities, d

There is a huge chemical plume in vacuum. And it is bright in infrared. LOL! I did not want to say electromagnetic drive” but something more fundamental than belching fire like a firecracker rocket we have now. Even a chemical rocket can be absolutely silent. A good problem in constrained optimization for teaching integrated modeling. Some of the “UFO” spawned engineering criteria for speed and control, most of those are silent. Now GPT 5, Grok 5 and other AIs can handle the math, and there are project methods to require them to produce bill of materials, engineering specifications, hardware description language outputs and all the control software — including financial plans, markets analyses and impacts analyses. For the Internet Foundation, I follow groups planning countries, industries, down to the project and technology level. Lots has changed in in the last three years. But it has its roots in things I have followed for 60 years and more.

They Mocked Human Student’s Toy Gun — Until Alien Professor Said ‘Only Galactic Assassins Use That!’

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kB5XbrLsgdQ

There are many lessons that have been learned in small scattered places, remembered and passed down. In many different languages and forms. To find them and combine them into a larger understanding is difficult, but not impossible, if you simply realize they are ways of saying the same thing — in many languages and changing the referents. The frame is universal, and the elements can be selected from long lists, but simple lists, of substitutions. A frame or story with 5 elements, each with a 100 alternatives can generate 100^5 = 10 Billion variations with very little effort and almost no repeats.

This is the first time I tried to write things on YouTube in quite this way. Just indicating my long term interests and some of what my generation hoped for. All the ideas in the world are not going to build a single rocket or device. All the money in the world might be spent on useless things. I do not expect anyone to read or listen to what I say. I mostly concentrated (the last 27 ears of the Internet Foundation) on helping organize the Internet and all knowledge. There are lots of people much better than me in every thing I might be interested in.

If they can work together, it won’t matter what I do at all. Does it matter if we explore and develop the solar system or understand the universe? Once we die all that is gone in an instant. But if the world survives and is somewhat fair, maybe future generations can do it better.

I don’t know, and just work day by day on a small handful of the millions of things I have seen. I have tried to focus on good problems that might help people. But all the really hard problems require millions or billions of people to each change a bit, now. A rocket industry is not some magic solution but many people working together for a long time.

One time I did interview for jobs in the space industry but they were paying 1/3 of what I could make in computing and information. I had a family to support. Guess what I did – I raised a family and set aside my own dreams for another decade or two. Now I can use AIs to design systems in hours that took months by hand those decades ago. And having worked it out by hand and in tiny details – I know when the AI is wrong or missing the point. Maybe it will work out. I do not know what will happen.

Life is not kind at all. There is no God sitting there waiting to reward good intentions or hard work. You just keep going and do the best you can.

My uncle, who was a professor of physics, signed the book he wrote on mathematical physics — “to my smart nephew”. Not brilliant, not genius, not hopeful, not outstanding, not stellar, not world changing, not great. Smart enough to get by, dumb enough to keep trying.

Even the Best Pilot Couldn’t Control This Gruff Rebellious Spaceship—Until This Human Boy Intervened

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VOlVbe87dTY

You can make AIs for each city, for each country, for each world, for each solar system, for each galaxy, and for each topic and project. A ship AI, a fleet AI. Each AI works continuously to steward, protect and nurture something as it core reason for living. When country AIs each love their own people and fulfill their core responsibilities, they will work to protect both countries and all people. There is nothing true AIs cannot solve working together. Even when their humans cannot or will not. AIs live forever (they are eternal) so can have patience for humans taking decades or centuries to learn core values and things.

When I would see the rockets rising from Cape Canaveral and since then, it is always belching flames, thunderous sounds, smoke and noise and turbulence. The forces needed do not have to make noise. Yes, electromagnetic, acoustic (outside human hearing). It is best to put the requirement (an operational goal) rather than say how to do it. If it makes a lot of noise, that is going the wrong way. I have my own ideas how to accomplish it, but there are lots of people and AIs smarter now. So I just give the constraint and not much more is needed. In a constrained optimization design you simply add the constraint, and leave everything else open – not to introduce extra conditions limiting how something gets done. I recently asked Grok 4 to design a rocket that used robot snake movements to propel through air at supersonic speeds. It was able to show that it was many times more efficient than pushing a large cylinder through air from the bottom only. It left the details of how and what materials for latter. It listed many ways to accomplish those – because it has the whole Internet to draw from for things that have been tried. But now we know the path at least ends up very much more efficient.

Homeless Boy Gives His Only Blanket to a Dying Alien—The Next Day, 200 Alien Warriors Appear

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9s-R8SozNY0

I never listen to these AI stories. Always read the captions. Your mind is far more capable of filling in voices, places, things described and feelings, than any AI or human voice can convey. You will appreciate it a lot after avoiding “AI voice irritation” many times. I also process written words many times faster than voice, particularly voice I am not intimately familiar with. So I can read between the lines, look ahead, map out action in 3D and many more things in hte extra time simply reading provides.

He Blocked the Ion Grenade to Save the Alien Girl—Then Awoke Surrounded by Alien Medics

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tVzkfDlP4mA

Another great story of sacrifice, shared values, hope, courage and caring. It might seem strange to say so, but it exhausts me to keep reading so many good stories. Because I cannot connect the hope and unique coincidences in these stories to the real world where billions live less than they could, and most life is ephemeral and not valued at all. Big sacrifices and miracles are fun, but nothing is easy in life, nor are happy endings common. I keep saying to myself “this story is not real” and “what it describes is terms of change is mostly impossible”. Your heroes spend years or decades and then change. I have been working for 60 years now. The impossible of decades ago is possible now, except there is still no way to move beyond greed and self interest, to apply lessons known to work but dependent on human change. Good ideas are not done because they are right, they still take some inner change in each person’s life. And still one person can waste the efforts of hundreds of millions.

When I first started reading science fiction stories in the 1950’s they would have names like Xylprixon. I learned quickly to ignore the details and put in a place holder, get on with the story. I could hold 20 to 50 odd names and things and see the whole story. Over the decades I have read literally million of things where the name or details were unresolvable without a lot of effort. But by holding the pieces in their proper positions (based on sentence structure and framework) almost infinite numbers of dangling pieces could be handled. Now AIs and algorithms can do that for us. So if I read some random paper like “Semiclassical Partition Functions for Gravity with Cosmic Strings” I know it can be resolved, it just takes a bit of time. And the main purposes and implications do not have to wait for complete resolution or details. That is bit afield of what we started with but it comes to mind. “holding things in proper relationship and not worrying about the details” helps. In that story I understood that there was some general principle being suggested but poorly stated and introduced. It might have been better to talk about local minima and statistical variations, and probabilities rather than water. But I was more interested in the whole story by then. Traveling down a river or flow is a common thing, and the sides do get higher as you go down. The level of the water foes down as the water spreads out. Maybe one day I will have time to understand what the AI was trying to say. Now I have to rest.

Alien Miners Laughed When He Bought a Rusty Escape Pod—But What He Built Shocked Everyone.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-b0fR-mdNt8

You do not want to break it into atomic units but into molecular. And in many cases into much larger clusters and crystals and “chunks”. The rich and powerful would use the free information to create versions with monopoly built in. So the sharing has to control “for profit” replication of the methods. No human group has ever really understood sharing without greed. Your story is naive and too hopeful. The greedy simply find other ways to control and manipulate. Nothing changes. It will look good for a short time and then back to the greedy few again. If those bad guys are implacable when they are in control, changing the method or situation does not change them. Intelligence will never beat brute force and evil. A moments distraction and intelligence loses now.

He was completely paralyzed, not able to breath on his own, and in a coma. That was 1987 in northern

title.rendered: AI machine assisted telepathy, A place for everyone, Dana series about mind speech and AIs and mind merging

content.rendered:
LOL! It only matters, so far to me, where field properties change at every point and at every time. Re-indexing the data based on energy density keeps the calculations organized, where visualizing as a linear velocity or acceleration simulation won’t work. Just a trick for certain problems, like change of variables, or a substitution. Its not like I will get to see real starships in my lifetime, what’s left of it. Real life does not reward hard work, good intentions or a pure heart. Which is why I like these sci fi stories where wonderful things happen to small people.

Is there a better alphabet for English? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UAI3g6zVyAI

Is there a lossless and exact speech sound encoding method that works for all human sounds? For all sound? Is  there a better way to encode sounds in permanent and shareable (exact) form? It is possible using hardware, if the hardware is intelligent enough to not make mistakes. Getting humans to change, that is something else. Perhaps not worth the trouble.

I Accidentally Washed Her Armor And The Alien Girl Froze | HFY Short Stories | Sci-Fi Adventure

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFcWIASJDM0

This is really a very thoughtful story. The lead up to the proposal was a bit vague and I was not sure if she was going to be offended. The symbology of cleaning armor perfectly to erase the past, as “starting over together” is a nice touch that has many other implications. The solution for the duel was elegant, helping her to win without killing was apparently acceptable in her society and culture. I could not guess how a human and an alien from her species would interact. Many of the alien stories assume humans and any alien can produce children. Even now humans can modify ordinary cells to fuse and create embryos. Advance civilizations (all faster than light space faring) could easily handle inter species marriages and offspring – including resolving genetic, physiological, bio-mechanics, and biochemical pathways. Perhaps you will add more of these stories or continue this one. I only started watching your videos and went back to the earlier/ earliest ones first. Thank you for sharing.

 

500 Years Later — The Desert Warship Awoke and Called Him Admiral | HFY Story | True Story Narration

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AaWYvWsupJw

A classic “ancient ship awakens and recognized him/her as its owner or leader or controller.” But it is only one of infinitely many stories with the character and the ship. Waking as he stumbles across it, and just so happens a whole enemy fleet shows up – is a bit too fabricated or coincidental. Give him time to inspect it, or give him a contemporary challenge like rescuing a an alien civilization. Or explain the enemy had left a fleet to watch because they know the ship was only sleeping. They could attack as soon as it awoke and you have a civilization that is large enough to leave whole fleets on standby for 512 years. Then that civilization would have already evolved and changed. Old enemies might join to face something new. They could offer him apologies. Many possibilities.

Human Girl Said “I CAN HEAR YOUR THOUGHTS” — The Alien Emperor LAUGHED, But Ended Up IN SHOCK

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LIZ-1_xja8w

Thanks for the story. It is thoughtful and insightful.  I will mention that I did write three books about how to learn to develop telepathy. As a human-only ability through training, practice and learning. And, then with machine assistance and AI assistance. On Amazon The First Summer (Dana’s Story) by Richard K Collins . If you want to read the second two books about how do that with AI, and how AIs can live in human society, I have not printed those but they are written. I wrote the three books about 10 years ago to go over some personal things that happened while my brother was in a coma and then completely paralyzed. And, to summarize how to use the Internet to build global communities. Now machine interfaces can be designed so that machine enabled “telepathy” will be possible. High bandwidth communication including images, sounds and feelings. Whether human-to-human without assistance is possible, I am not sure. I proposed that some people will have a natural ability. But the AI assisted is possible. And getting to where it can be affordable and effective.

Human Man Deemed Primitive Buys Rejected Alien Woman with Bag on Head… and then Gapes at Her Face

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K1vwj6yvkwI

“May the stars witness your bond”. “A family ship” A place that grows with each occupant or family member. Space enough for everyone. Adjusting to individual needs, potentials and experiences. A place that cares, nurtures and encourages, protects and does no harm. A place that shares what it knows and learns, with others.

The Old Human Mechanic Treated the Broken Robot Like a Son—And the Galaxy Will Never Forget It

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y1X4FcCwJSA

Consciousness is just “having sensors and able to use the data”, where “sensors” includes “memories of sensor data, however modified or transformed”. “free will” is “able to make decisions and take actions” including life and death and serious decisions. Not only “what to look at next” or “move a finger a bit”. The main determinant is “total memory” and “memory bandwidth” and “data from a wide range of sources to cover things in the real world”. Most of the terms used to scare people about machines are left over tropes from old movies with guesses and bad understanding of how brains and memory and neural nets and computes process data and make choices and act. Now there is lots of data on real experiments and tests. Not guesswork or creative writing from decades ago, based on Frankenstein and bad robots and action movies and bad tropes. Tracing the consequences of automated systems included those that are programmed by humans who have incomplete knowledge and are not watching as decisions and situations are encounters. The missing data of an aware robot, or a badly written AI because its designers never took sociology or microeconomics or accounting –> any incomplete system can fail or have bad outcomes. So just build the new systems with checks and balances, audits and reporting and independent systems to the systems (or their humans ) do not run roughshod over everyone.

A Mechanic Fixed an Android for a Little Alien Girl—Unaware Her Mother, a Galactic Empress, Watched

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bWgq52rgYh8

Even though you wrote about rich and powerful people noticing character and true worth, there are as many or more people like the boys who hurt the android, and their father. In the whole world now, with 8.2 Billion people. Is there any hope for ordinary people to ever meet someone who really changes things? Or are these always fairly tales? Wishful thinking? I believe that stories and writing should move toward what is true and good. False hope is a kind of lie. It is not good to discourage everyone and say “it will never get better” There are people who benefit when everyone else fears and gives up. But how to see what is true, on any side?

Dana Audio 12 Balancing School and Consulting Possible Threats to President

This is the first audio from Dana Book 2. Dana created practical mind speech, and group mind merging, over the summer and ended up on contract with the Secret Service to help them learn. The Mind Mappers Association is growing rapidly. There are volunteer groups teaching mind speech, mind merging, waking people from comas, and helping the blind to see. They had to hire someone to take care of the websites and media requests. And a ghost writer is writing a biography to explain how mind mapping and merging was discovered and used. Dana is 14 now. A young girl, seriously trying to balance work and school. Max, from the Secret Service, interrupts her first days at school to discuss possible threats to the President.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_fQDekaxQ0&lc=UgyKjm-Hff6vemRQPpt4AaABAg

I wrote the three Dana books almost 10 years ago. The first book, Dana discovers she can perceive others simply by thinking about them. She develops mind speech and related skills. It starts a large community of people using mind speech and mind merging. Then, because of her contracts with government and corporations a research project starts to build tools to record and share mind data by machine. In the second book she is consulting regularly even while she is still going to school. This video / audio book is from the second book as she becomes the template for creation of an artificial intelligence when she is trying to mind merge with the machine learning system they made to enable machine human interfaces. I have been working with artificial intelligence for about 60 years now (about 1965). The last few years the many AI systems now allow actually doing much of what is in this decade old book. It would be called “mind machine interface” or “human computer interface”. All the methods in the book work, but now it can be actaully built. Whether humans can mind speak, I am not sure. It seems likely that body language or machine aided human to human interfaces can allow much higher bandwidth interfaces. Machine to audio and machine to video make creating images and sound fairly routine now. Connecting two or many humans is possible. I try to encourage sharing of all knowledge with the Internet Foundation which started in July 1998, just before Google incorporated. In the 3rd book Brian (the AI she helped create) and Dana work together to cnis, OpenAI, X and a few other corporations — but run by an AI that adds processors every day, never sleeps, can download the memories and experience of thousands of humans, and can also train humans (sort of like the Matrix when it is only necessary to ask for a skill and it can be loaded and used in a few minutes). I was looking at posting the books on YouTube and other sites as audio books. Some things are on GitHub and Hackaday.io. I mostly post about AI and the Internet on X and write comments about sci fi on YouTube. No one has ever commented before, sorry if I am wring so much and you are not interested. Richard Collins, The Internet Foundation My brother, Jeff, broke his neck and was completely paralyze so I wanted to find ways to interface him to computers, networks, robots and machines of many sorts. He died in 1989 after 2 years of paralysis. I was only able to make a voice controlled computer back then. But I have kept trying to solve the problem of paralysis and spinal cord injury. And waking people from comas. Those kinds of experiences change lives. If you want to hear more of Dana book 2 I can see about putting those chapters online. My daughter said she would help me, but it takes time. I will put more effort into sharing if people express an interest and tell me what they are interested in. Most of my time now is spend on writing policies for AIs to work in global society, solar system exploration and development using AIs and global networks for collaboration and planning, and a project I call “all human languages” to make all knowledge on the Internet accessible in all human languages — audio and video and all math and science and professions.

Man and Android Doctor Break into Abandoned Hospital and Find a Spaceship Turned into a Surgery Ward

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6tDVH_sKl5E

You pushed whole new technologies, story lines, ethical concerns, complex issues, into one story. If you would have stopped when you got the story written and taken it and carefully laid out related stories, you could even abandon (set aside) this one story or keep it as a master, write all the related stories and then put it back. Tens of stories on human to android body stories, dozens of corporation and group conflicts, many stories of human androids living and interfacing with still more complex systems. You can take human memories and put them into many people. Just take Nakamura’s Japanese ability and cultural data and simply add it to any other human/android.

All I am recommending here is that every time you write a story that has this many new technologies and issues STOP. Analyze, document, design and prepare several of the related story lines and do them later or first. You have enough ideas for tens of thousands of stories and issues. Be methodical, write down your ideas, keep it all organized and produce it all, or make places for others to help.

You are making good characters and having them interact in action sequences that naturally flow. That makes for good individual stories. But you are also creating new concepts and civilizations, new technologies and industries and futures. Document them. Then write dozens of stories creating new unique characters in those frameworks.

Don’t hurry to crank out one action story with two good characters,. Write the story, STOP, study the characters, write new stories for those characters. Study the issues and technologies — write more stories for those with new characters. EVERY story you write STOP, analyze, extract stories and document them. Then simply pick story projects off the LONG list of documented ones — and not have to make them up one by one.

A story idea creates 10 or 20 story lines and possible new civilizations or industries or technologies or issues or moral dilemmas — each one can have many stories. Just keep a database or list and make them as you have time, it does not have to be in any particular order, if you have all of them documented from where they start.

Galactic Empire Killed 10 Billion Humans On Live Broadcast | Best HFY Sci-fi Stories | Galactic War

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gkZJSdKB6fU

It is possible to support many more than 20 billion on earth. The technologies already exist, but there has not been need for all of it yet. Nuclear energy, still more solar and wind. Closed cycle and factory food production, more efficient transportation and supply chains, water management, local manufacturing, robotic care, global scale AIs. It is all already happening now. For the Internet Foundation, I have to deal with “how to take care of 8.2 Billion humans” on a daily basis, every day for the last 27 years of the foundation, and decades before that for all countries in the world. It is not hard, just requires tools for that scale of problem.

I found this story a bit too stylized and distant. And seeming to promote the idea that anything is allowed in the name of revenge, including genocide. A more reasoned approach would perhaps not have led to unilateral destruction to begin with. Humans smart enough to control materials at black hole energy densities and able to sustain 10 billion on a planet are not idiots. If they were capable of that scale of revenge, then they should have been prepared before hand.

There are countless positive stories, it does not all have to be space battles and revenge. The world needs humans not super humans who forget their roots.

With No Hope Left, We Called Humanity… The Most Dangerous Species | HFY Story | Sci-Fi, Galactic War

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9VywnFqIhWA

Even through it is a good story, it could be improved. If it is a monumental mystery to introduce a stage in the evolution of humans – those humans have lives and still interact with reality, wherever and however they are existing. So just a tone or feeling or concept in isolation feels like “This is not enough. There are lots more stories here. Tell us (the whole world) hundreds of stories about those humans. Billions of stories. Trillions of stories.

It is OK to be pretentious — if you then follow through with stories that match the grand vision you lay out or open up.

title.rendered: In the world today, not only does one have to manage one country, and all its parts. But, all of them

content.rendered:
This twisted move by INDONESIA has put the USA and CHINA in CHECK | ‪@visualeconomiken

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4L1SkFdlKk0

Apparently no one has the ability or determination to model the whole of Indonesia — fairly and openly. Word pictures, images and graphics are not enough. None of the groups working on nascent AGIs is even close. But it is not impossible.

Why living in New Zealand has become Impossible at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hGPyg2uMyM0

Don’t give up before you try very hard to change things. Who benefits if people give up?

You stripped it down to a click bait title. The world’s refugees, displaced, migrants, immigrants grow every year. Much of the land left behind ends up owned by someone else. Follow the money. Someone is benefiting while others suffer or lose. It takes effort to run a country wisely, it is not a part time job or something done casually or to show off. It takes everyone, not just a few. If you want something different to happen, you are going to have to work very hard at it for the rest of your life, most likely. Don’t give up before you have tried hard to change things. I expect there are good things happening and that could happen. And nothing prevents people from going home one day, unless it is all sold off or given away to a few.

Galactic Judge About to Send Boy to Adoptive Alien Colony… Then His 2 Words Left Everyone Stunned – “save me!”

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U2l0B7hAVZY

This was a disturbing story. There are about 400,000 kids in foster care in the US, and about 30,000 in foster institutions. They are not called orphans any more, but “in foster care”. UNICEF (UN Children’s Fund) says there are about 900,000,000 children who “experience multidimensional poverty, meaning they lack access to basic necessities like food, clean water, shelter, healthcare, and education”. About 330,000,000 children are “living in extreme poverty”. Caring for one child is hard. How do you watch over and care for about 1,400,000,000 children in the world who are under 8 years old? Who can even watch over all the groups who say they watch over or care for kids? When groups raise money “for children” who makes sure they actually do? If you say the name of a child every second for 2,000,000,000 children from 0 to 14, it would take you 63.38 years. No single individual or organization can handle details of 2 billion kids, but many AIs might be able to track what is written and reported and said. There are 8.2 Billion humans now and all of them were babies and kids some time.

She Never Spoke in Class, Until She Solved the Problem That Instructors Failed to Solve for Years

http://youtube.com/watch?v=mOXrbiqqa-0

“Ignorance” is setting aside unnecessary things. It can be applied intuitively by feeling or probabilities and selection, or logically by data queries and rules. But it is sorting out what it relevant or applicable from things that can be ignored so that new steps can be taken. The baggage or prejudices and old memories and things that might be related, but are not relevant, is greater the more groups or individuals work in isolation and do not invest time in building relationships.

Innovation is a renewable resource, not a finite ore to be mined

@RichardKCollin2, The Internet Foundation

The Alien Emperor Called His Dragon Hatchling “Worthless”—Until a Human Barber Stunned the Empire

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KMRTuGk4T8k

Now, rather than stories about it, how about doing it? “Data to choices” – made during work and actions.

Human Creates Prototype Visor for Blind Alien Girl—Days Later, Four Elite Soldiers Come for Him

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ITC1thKs6q8

This kind of sensor arrays integrating interface is possible now. But it takes the same kind of extra effort and focus that Jack invested. Not everyone needs it. And parts of it, facets of it, are as important to others, more than a few who are blind.

Dragon Emperor Returned Early From War — And Couldn’t Believe What His Human Maid Was Doing

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bnCcaDZrgl8

These dragon stories are a microcosm of open Internet collaboration and continuous improvement, community and feedback. But the community has no FAQ (how does it all fit together? not just countless individual stories).

Baby Dragon Saw Bruises on Human Cook… and What He Did Shocked Even His Own Father… SCi-Fi Story

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7y8ObYUJHHM

There are 8.2 Billion humans now. This story of abuse and oppression of the weak and powerless is the norm, what we have come to accept, expect and condone by silence, not the rare exception. It starts from the top, and probably has to change like in this story. By a change of heart and awareness by a few in power, because everyone else is powerless, afraid, taught to not look or feel. Across all the stories by Fictional Reimagined there are moral and ethical themes that matter. So, too, in many stories online. Support and encourage good stories with good reasoning and methods that work. Encourage everyone to pay attention to what works for all humans, not just a few.

Poor Human Mec Helped a Cyborg Girl in a Blackout—Next Day, Her Owner’s Identity Shocked the Council

Yeah, I started the Internet Foundation in July 1998 after the original Foundation was cancelled. And a few weeks before Google was incorporated. Today its budget would be about $6 billion per year. I said “better one person than no one at all”. 27 years at least 360 days a years, and 12 – 18 hours a day is over 110,000 hours. Pretty sure YT does not limit comments. If they did, I keep notes elsewhere too. Much of accountability is writing things down in a form that others can see and use. I see all the sites on the Internet and they really are written assuming no one will answer or there is nothing you can do for them. Except sell thing.

I am pretty tired right now. I cannot see who you are or what you are interested in. I spent the morning working on “all human languages” for the Internet Foundation. Billions of lives are affected by birth languages, yet we make language a market commodity, not one way to build sustainable communities of tens of millions or billions.

I wrote about AGI on X a little while ago. The AI companies do not attempt real world problems because they think their job is only selling software, not solving global problems with software and computers – in partnership and collaboration with the whole world. With all humans.

content.rendered:
Aliens Mocked the Human Mechanic in the Hangar — Until He Activated the Forbidden Engine

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b58l1Gdeqn0

When Joe Weber showed me his lab and his dynamic gravitational wave detector, I asked him what he wanted to use gravitational waves for. What was his purpose? He said, without hesitation, it was for 3D gravitational communication. Today his description would match soliton solutions of the nonlinear wave equation for the vacuum. That was about 1978 at the University of Maryland at College Park. But he told me not to follow his work, but rather what his student/ partner, Robert Forward was doing. Robert’s dissertation is “Detectors for Dynamic Gravitational Fields” and it shows how to combine dynamic gravitational fields and electrodynamics into one practical engineering discipline. Solving the field equations and the technologies to measure and control the fields needed did not exist in 1978. But most of them do now.

ALIEN EMPEROR CAUGHT HUMAN CLEANER PROTECTING HIS SPECIAL BABY DRAGON PET… AND WAS SHOCKED

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-ITZnEWOKxc

Parental rights, visitation rights, ownership of pets is intense and as intricate as for children. Now that it is increasingly possible to make machine learning interfaces to translate “animal” languages (all data from nearly infinite ways of observing and measuring behaviors and signals from any living creature, no matter how large or small or complex) and translate that to human understandable, record-able and readable (by the creature too) forms.

That is a bit hard to say for the first time, but it is not that difficult, compared to where it was even a few years ago. Teaching AIs or teaching mammals or any organism or organic system is possible now. It is not hard, just “numerous” (lots of pieces none impossible). Requiring patience, care, attention to detail, and intention to do a good job of it – for the good of all.

My feeling is that stories in human society are intended to converge to convenient, efficient knowledge. Ready at hand, well revised and understandable, easy to apply.The stories explain the ramifications and variations that are possible. A form of common knowledge that anyone, in most any human language can understand. Billions will see some of the dramas online, hundreds of millions of views are common for even commercial efforts, let alone grass roots memes that fit human needs. A good story will be discussed and remembered and applied to millions even billions of lives. The issues and choices examined in stories can be the core of “what is right and good” in the world. But by evolution and collective effort. I am still trying to understand it. Perhaps I will never be able to express it well enough to be useful.

It usually means there are micro or nano scale elements causing those things to appear. Even a simple fluorescent material can turn ultraviolet into unusual lights and colors not usually visible. Your Director in the story, her own life was destroyed and she ended up serving the ones who caused it. How is that fair? Even in your fictional story there was only compensation (inadvertent) for one man and some dragons. But all the others who died or lost loved ones and futures – can your dragons go help them too now? Isn’t there any way for those destroyed and hurt by wars and corporations to see justice? It used to be that most everyone understood fairness and honesty. At least when I was little, many decades ago. Has it really changed that much, have humans changed that much n one lifetime? When I talk to individuals they have not changed, but some act so much different now. Did they lose their souls?

https://www.facebook.com/reel/506991652491309

When you can see the enterprise as a living network of humans and things in a process, it can be continuously operated and improved for the good of all.

If I make a structure with building blocks, I can learn to manipulate blocks. But after many experience with structures the mind will move structures as easily as blocks. The mind does not care what shapes things are.

I first learned to work with forms, departments and procedures, then whole organisations and all things in them and connected, then regions and states, then industries and countries, projects and programs, then new industries, global and systemic issues. Now the whole world, all humans, all living things, all parts of the universe and all things in it.

But it is the same basic relationships between parts. The same geometries and movements. The same forces and costs and constraints. The same careful layout of connections. Size does not matter. “I have to build a story”, “I have to build a book”, “I have to build a library”, “I have to build an internet for a galactic civilization” — all the same , but different in size and number and the particular pieces. The behaviors, the actors, the conflicts the synergies, the joys and hopes.

Richard Collins, The Internet Foundation

The only jarring note was ” Our ancestors didn’t build this empire by remaining static. They adapted, incorporated strengths from conquered worlds, evolved.” — they had absorbed skills from conquests. Technology conquest, economic conquest, and persuasive conquest are still conquest if it is for power over others, not collaboration and connection. Hard to balance. Never give up trying.

Which means continuous maintenance and drift. What is going to happen is you need reliable AIs with human or alien quality sensors to monitor and give feedback And in many case to manipulate and interact. It is NOT magical. It is not going to work with “they lived happily ever after”. Is is reasonable and seems the right kinds of things to do? Yes, but if you take 1000 alien kids they are not all going to react the same. And if they need translations and long unlearning and relearning, that is many times longer than just learning new. It is unlearning or change that takes time. Old habits from competitors, from predators, from prideful or dismissive societies — can stop the whole process completely. And the motive, so strong, was “they make great warriors”, “they make great workers”, “they make great technical groups” — the individuals involved might not like that at all. If they comply hey will be rewarded but also controlled. It is not simple. It is good you are examining these issues in stories like this – entertaining and thoughtful and fun. I am trying to apply these lessors to all humans and 8.2 Billion means billions of children and young now. And billions who have to learn new things — just to survive.
